heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 119–60, div. C, title XXXI, § 3111(b)(5), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1458

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 112–74, div. B, title III, § 306, Dec. 23, 2011, 125 Stat. 877, related to treatment of general plant projects with an estimated cost of less than $10,000,000. See section 6274 of Title 10, Armed Forces. Provisions similar to those in this section were contained in Pub. L. 111–8, div. C, title III, § 310, Mar. 11, 2009, 123 Stat. 627.
